about: Goblins stuck in a cell after loading (players: goblins pacing in BIRTH 2 / production cells, leaving only when the captive is removed). Some saves hold a goblin walking into its cell with 'follow' still on, which pins it to the cell's edge. The load sweep used to seat such walkers straight into the in-cell state without arriving (scr_mon_contact never ran), so the cell never started and the goblin stayed for good. Three are set up in idle occupied cells, saved and reloaded; no monster may then stay in the same cell for 1900+ frames (patrols excluded).
